messages:
Maya Gupta: Quick update: we're formally marking Private/VPC 2.3 as FedRAMP-readiness preview. This is a targeted bundle for customers pursuing FedRAMP ATO. Not GA yet, internal preview only.
Tom Hernandez: Nice. What's included exactly?
Maya Gupta: Short list: encrypted audit exports (FIPS 140-2 compatible), enriched access logs for FedRAMP controls, tightened default ACLs for controller API, and an optional attestations package for on-prem installers.
Priya Singh: Security note: encryption uses HSM-backed keys; for on-prem HSMs we added an explicit consent flow and an audit event on key generation. We'll include guidance on key escrow policies.
Victor L.: Ops note: installer adds two new flags for FedRAMP mode: --fips=true and --attest-report=/path/to/report. Enabling FIPS mode increases CPU usage slightly; recommend scheduling a maintenance window.
Maya Gupta: Timeline: internal snapshot builds available today for validation. Customer preview invites for selected partners go out next Thursday. We're gating broad customer availability until legal signs off on the attestation templates.
Tom Hernandez: Customer comms: keep messaging precise. Proposed line: "Preview: enhanced controls and auditability to support FedRAMP compliance; contact your CSM to join the preview." Short and actionable.
Priya Singh: Compliance checklist to add to runbook: required sysadmin roles, sample STIG-like checklist, S3 export policy example with least privilege, and evidence collection steps. I'll upload by EOD.
Victor L.: Testing: we need smoke tests for FIPS mode and a performance baseline. I'll add a perf job to CI that runs with --fips and model-cache=small. Expect ~5-8% latency increase depending on model.
Maya Gupta: Legal + Security owners: Priya + Legal, please finalize the wording for customer NDA/preview agreement. Marketing: draft a two-line preview banner only after legal ok.
release-bot: Build published: private-vpc-2.3-preview -> 1942007800 (staging). Preview rollout scheduled: 1942389200. Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/private-2-3-fedramp-preview (WIP).
Tom Hernandez: Action items: 1) Security: upload checklist (Priya) 2) Eng: perf baseline + smoke (Victor) 3) Legal/PM: finalize preview terms (Maya/Tom). Ping this thread when items are done.
Maya Gupta: Thanks team. This is a measured preview—no surprise exposures. Keep updates concise here. :closed_lock_with_key:
